guide.blueMage.title: Phantom Blue Mage
guide.blueMage.intro: Like the limited Blue Mage, phantom Blue Mage learns almost every spell from a specific enemy rather than from levelling. This page is a guide, not a tracker: the game does not tell plugins which spells you already know, so nothing here is ticked off automatically.
guide.blueMage.replacesPrevious: Replaces the previous rank once learned.
guide.blueMage.requiresAeroII: Requires Occult Aero II to have been learned first.
nav.reason.notInstalled: Auto-travel needs the vnavmesh plugin, which is not installed.
nav.reason.meshBuilding: vnavmesh is still building the navigation mesh for this zone.
nav.reason.disabledInSettings: Auto-travel is switched off in the settings.
nav.warningTitle: Auto-travel can get your account actioned
nav.warningBody: Moving your character automatically is exactly what Square Enix's terms forbid, and it is detectable. Nobody can promise you otherwise. Turn this on only if you accept that risk yourself, and use it sparingly and sensibly.
nav.warningAccept: I understand the risk and accept it
nav.warningShort: Detectable — can result in a ban. Use responsibly.
config.developerModeHint: Recomputes cached game data every frame instead of once. Slower — leave off unless you are editing the plugin's static catalogs.
guide.none: This zone has no guide yet.
config.zoneInactive: You are not in this zone right now.
config.useMount: Summon a mount for long routes
config.useMountHint: Uses Mount Roulette when the destination is far. vnavmesh does not do this itself, so Hornwatch summons the mount.
config.dependencyVnavmesh: Auto-travel requires the vnavmesh plugin. While auto-travel is on but vnavmesh is missing, the travel buttons stay visible and disabled with the reason on hover. While auto-travel is off, they are hidden entirely.
nav.reason.lifestreamMissing: Teleporting needs the Lifestream plugin, which is not installed. Travel still works, it just walks the whole way.
config.useTeleport: Teleport to the nearest point first
config.useTeleportHint: Uses Lifestream to reach the zone teleport point closest to the destination, then walks the rest. Skipped when you already stand closer to the destination than that point does.
config.useReturn: Cast Return to reach the aethernet
config.useReturnHint: The aethernet can only be used while standing at one of its points. When none is within walking distance, Return becomes Occult Return and sends you to the base camp, which is one. It is a 3s cast that breaks on damage, so it is retried; if it cannot be cast at all, travel simply walks instead.
config.dependencyLifestream: Teleporting requires the Lifestream plugin. Occult Crescent's teleport points are not standard aetherytes, and Lifestream is what knows how to reach them. Without it, travel simply walks the whole way.
config.mountRouletteHint: Summons a random mount, the same as the in-game roulette.
config.mountSpecificHint: Always summons this mount. If it turns out not to be unlocked on this character, the roulette is used instead.
config.themeFollowGameHint: Reads the interface theme selected in the game's own character settings. If the swatches above do not match your HUD, pick the theme explicitly instead.
watch.respawnUnknown: Next pot unknown - no pot has ended in front of you since you entered the zone.
